checks.requirement: All ADS/support documents pass strict schemas and cross-reference checks.
All committed fixtures pass deterministic sanitizer and prohibited-field checks.
Every declared non-empty native family owns exactly one top-level disposition.
Every selector and source primitive has finite auditable object/record bounds.
Every RFC 012D relation stays within declared roots and measured access budgets.
Exact, range, recognized-unverified, and incompatible artifacts select only promoted releases.
Incompatible public semantic versions fail before source access.
Source, entity, record, fact, and revision identities survive replay and registration reorder.
Head/prefix plus continuation equals full-only ordered records, facts, and final decoder state.

Response identity, exact repeats, evolving and downward snapshots, missing buckets, reused request IDs, actor attribution, and generation replacement reduce without duplicate contributions while legacy usage remains intact.
The frozen sanitized fixture reduces under an adapter-free qualified-bucket oracle with a stable detailed-state digest.
The real root and subagent decoders plus durable reducer match the independent oracle's qualified response, actor, session, fallback, and reset state.
Late workflow/team affiliations regroup existing actor usage while explicit removal, ambiguity, and generation replacement cannot duplicate or reburn canonical responses.
Unknown record families and fields remain bounded and measurable without native payload leakage.
Durable and scoped decoding produce identical semantic revision references.
